item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hi, my name is Martin,

I'm a Filipino and I've known the SCP foundation for a while, but it's only recently when I really got hooked into reading and even watching animations and readings on YouTube.
I decided to join to hopefully "do something".
Not quite sure whether I'll write an SCP entry or just be there to read and vote on SCPs.

I really really like to know more about this community, because currently, I'm still at the surface level in terms of knowledge of what the SCP foundation is.
And I would like to take a shot in contributing ideas for SCPs or even tales.

(About the random question) I'll say I'm air(?)
I'm just chill, going with the flow of the breeze.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey there,
Greetings from Canada. My name is Spencer, though I go by Zim almost everywhere else. I have followed SCP for years and decided I wanted to get more into the community of the Foundation I love. I figure I would make a small list of things about me below:

- I am really into video games, creepy things, family, animals, doing voices, and having a good time with my friends.
- I want to eventually create an SCP article that I can share, but in the mean time I might lurk or try to get involved.
- I love Star Wars and am looking to make a 'The Mandalorian' cosplay.
- I work.. a lot.
- For the question of the month, I would go with water..mostly because I like the rain.

That's my short hello! I am excited to meet some other SCP enthusiasts.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Admin Post - Info - Open
item.content:encoded:
Hello, my name is Dr. Ash Greywhind, I would like to be called Dr. Grey.

Obligatory note that the SCP wiki is not a roleplaying site—users in the forums don't refer to site members with in-universe names, and won't append titles like "doctor" that don't appear in usernames.

If you would like to be addressed with a certain name/title, make that your username (provided it follows the Join the Site rules).

item.content:encoded: Hello, my name is Dr. Ash Greywhind, I would like to be called Dr. Grey. I joined the site due to a fascination with all things abnormal. I really enjoy collecting strange nick-nacks and assorted objects, when I am in a gift shop at some zoo or theme park I tend to wander around until I find some weird object sitting at the back of the shelf and buy it. item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hello, my name is Dr. Hayden Hajovsky (Hi-yaw-ski). I've been interested in SCPs for while after I saw some videos on various SCPs on YouTube. I think my first was either SCP-3000 or SCP-5001. Either way, I ended up getting hooked, and being the ambitious person that I am, I hope to become a writer on the site, perhaps even connecting a few of my future SCPs together into a larger narrative. Some of my hobbies include writing, swimming, playing various video games, and taking care of my pet fire ants. I am excited to contribute to the site and discuss ideas with all of you. (The element that most describes me would probably be water, especially when it's ice.)

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey, I'm bubba808. I am a new user on the SCP wiki user that just got accepted today on 11/24/20. I recently got interested in the wiki again and finally pushed myself to apply and be able to interact with the community. It's possible I will change the name of my account in the future, but people can always refer to me as bubba or bubba808 and I will respond.

I am really looking forward to writing articles for this site because of the amazing ideas you can come up with. Whether its science fiction, horror, or a fairy tale there is something unique about writing on this website because it is collaborative and more open. Most of the writings here were just developed out of people's imaginations. Recently, I've been brainstorming up some SCPs and I have a few ideas. Although they are probably not that unique. I'm definitely not the best writer though so I hope to improve my writing during the course of my time here.

So this month's introduction question is what element best represents you. For me it would probably be earth or rock or whatever you want to call it because it is the most consistent and most sturdy element. I like to think I am reliable but that's debatable to say the least.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Good evening beautiful people. I'll be using the handle Influrrno (Before you ask, yes, I came up with that because I like fire and ice motifs just a little too much, and yes, my writing will probably reflect that).

I've only recently been exposed to SCP, but I've always been taken in by unconventional writing formats that breed creativity, so I've been reading up on my skips and tales over the past few months and having a good time.

My ideas for writing SCPs and tales are… well, I'm pretty sure they're mostly a complete mess conceptually (let's just say I have an idea relating to a steel cable that puts holes in people but also its own plot), but I consider myself at least competent in technical writing style, so we'll have to see how this goes. I'm extremely excited to get and give productive feedback, as I'm a strong believer in improvement by acknowledging your own shortcomings.

To answer the forum's question, my classical element would definitely be Earth. I'd like to think that's because I'm steadfast, consistent and solid, but I suspect it's more because I just don't like to move much.

Anyway, hopefully I end up contributing something interesting to the site, or failing that, a bit of friendliness. Cheers mates!
